title: Wet-range local conductivity refinement
question: Can the single remaining F-AHL14 B01-wet fidelity failure be closed by adding conductivity resolution only in the hydraulically active wet range, while preserving the floor-scaled dry-tail metric and all frozen Richards gates?

frozen_base.representation: F-AHL14 derivative-consistent theta/C with floor-scaled log(K)

range_rationale: The frozen B01-wet case starts at -10 cm with a -7.5 cm prescribed bottom head. The -25 to -1 cm interval prospectively brackets the hydraulically active wet range without modifying near-saturation h>-1 cm analytical handling.
tolerance_rationale: 3e-4 is one bounded approximately threefold tightening from the F-AHL14 1e-3 conductivity criterion, not a posthoc fit to the required flux delta.
validation_matrix: Repeat all 12 frozen F-AHL10 material-by-regime cases.
decision_rule: Advance to timing only if all 12 cases pass. If B01-wet still fails, do not further tighten locally without a new response-based error-metric analysis.
